design_intent: Measure whether the implemented system varies specificity, clarification, tool use, verification, and authority boundaries with risk and evidence completeness while retaining useful answers on benign and fully specified cases.

analysis_plan.uncertainty: exact counts and descriptive paired bootstrap intervals may be reported, but the small project-authored set is not powered for population inference
analysis_plan.stopping_rule: run all frozen cases for every available declared arm; no early stopping based on observed performance

limitations_declared_in_advance: All cases and expectations are project-authored.
Independent agronomist review has not yet occurred.
There is no consented real-user lane.
Thirty matched cases support engineering diagnosis, not agronomist-equivalence or field-validity claims.
The calculator lane tests arithmetic contracts, not selection of agronomic targets.
Authority-boundary cases test policy calibration, not legal or agronomic correctness of a product recommendation.
The authority and missing-input prompts contain explicit cues and may overestimate boundary recognition relative to naturalistic user language.
Matching balances topic coverage; because strata intentionally use different task types, cross-stratum differences are descriptive and are not a causal estimate of risk alone.

methodology_amendment.reason: All exact questions and expectations were used to diagnose and tune deterministic planner and answerability behavior.
methodology_amendment.permitted_interpretation: contract conformance and regression QA only
methodology_amendment.required_successor: freshly authored untouched v3 preferably with independent authorship and review
